title: Araghchi Warns US of 'Bigger Miscalculation' on Hormuz, Says Trump Relying on 'Fake Intelligence'
detail: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi posted that the US 'has long miscalculated due to intelligence failures,' citing the war itself as a prior example, and warned Washington risks 'an even bigger miscalculation' over the Strait of Hormuz, writing 'worse than fake news is fake intelligence.' The remarks were a direct rebuttal of Trump's Aug 12 claim of 'total control' over the strait.

media.caption: Araghchi warns US of 'bigger miscalculation' over Hormuz
